question: How do I define SDK variables in my OpenAPI specification that can be used across multiple endpoints?
ground_truth: To define SDK variables in your OpenAPI specification, use the `x-fern-sdk-variables` extension at the document level to declare the variables with their type and description. Then, mark specific path parameters as SDK variables by adding `x-fern-sdk-variable` to the parameter definition with the corresponding variable name. These variables are set once during SDK client initialization and automatically used in path parameters across all endpoint calls.

metadata.cited_context:
Define variables at the document level using `x-fern-sdk-variables`, then mark path parameters as variables using `x-fern-sdk-variable`:

```yaml
x-fern-sdk-variables:
  gardenId:
    type: string
    description: The unique identifier for your garden
  zoneId:
    type: string
    description: The zone within the garden

paths:
  /gardens/{gardenId}/zones/{zoneId}/plants:
    get:
      operationId: list_plants_in_zone
      parameters:
        - name: gardenId
          in: path
          required: true
          x-fern-sdk-variable: gardenId
          schema:
            type: string
```
